title: Hephaestus mesh dispatch envelope hi/v1
description: Versioned structural compatibility schema for the hi/v1 dispatch-envelope shape derived from Proposed ADR-013 §3, Proposed ADR-020 §6, and the checked-in M0 stage-chaining fields. Validation proves packet shape only; it does not prove routing, worker, retry, exhaustion, or deployment behavior. An incompatible envelope shape requires a new schema version rather than an in-place reinterpretation of hi/v1.

msg_id.description: Globally unique message id for idempotent handling (ADR-013 §3).

repo.description: GitHub repository the task belongs to, as {org}/{name} (ADR-020 §6).

issue.description: GitHub issue number that is the single source of truth for this task (ADR-020 §6).

branch.description: Git branch holding code truth for this task (ADR-020 §6).

base_branch.description: Branch to base work on; defaults to the repository trunk when absent.

blocked_by.description: Issue numbers this task depends on (ADR-013 §3).

domain.description: Dispatch domain; pipeline or research today (ADR-013 role-addressed dispatch), extensible to new domains without a schema bump.

role.description: Role name addressed by the dispatch subject hi.myrmidon.{domain}.{role}.task.{task_id} (ADR-013 §2).

stage.description: Stage value carried by the current hi/v1 compatibility artifact. The enum mirrors the stage names in Proposed ADR-020 §2; the schema neither accepts that proposal nor proves runtime chaining. Learn has no first-class value in this schema.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt counter for this stage dispatch; part of the idempotency preamble key (ADR-013 §4).

plan_cycles.description: Counter field associated with proposed plan-to-plan-review cycles; default annotation 2.

rebase_conflict.description: Counter field associated with proposed rebase-conflict handling; default annotation 2.

pr_review_hard.description: Counter field associated with the proposed aggregate PR-review ceiling; default annotation 6.

merge.description: Counter field associated by Proposed ADR-020 §3 with merge retries; default annotation 5.

budgets.description: Nonnegative budget fields carried by the current hi/v1 compatibility artifact. Proposed ADR-020 describes possible decrement and exhaustion behavior, but JSON Schema does not enforce or prove those runtime transitions.

verdict.description: Optional outcome value in the compatibility shape; the schema permits go, no_go, or null and does not prove downstream stage behavior.

reason.description: Human-readable cause of the no-go outcome.

evidence.description: Verbatim failing evidence (log excerpts, check names, review threads) for the receiving agent.

remediation.description: Optional remediation-object shape derived from Proposed ADR-020 §3. When present it requires reason and evidence and rejects unknown remediation fields; the schema does not prove who creates, publishes, or consumes it.
